basic_info.description: Discover unparalleled modern living at 1187 Stanyan Street, an extraordinary home that epitomizes contemporary sophistication and architectural brilliance. This exceptional property offers over 4,000 square feet of meticulously crafted space across three thoughtfully designed levels. The coveted floor plan perfectly accommodates today's lifestyle with 5 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, sophisticated entertaining spaces on the main level, and a flexible lower-level ideal for guests or home office use. Set on a deep, verdant lot with lush green space surrounding the property, this remarkable residence feels like a private retreat in the heart of the city.
